# RosterHockey

RosterHockey (previously written Roster Hockey or Roster) is a hockey-specific team and league management app for iOS and Android. It helps teams and leagues organize schedules, attendance, team chat, dues and payments, substitute and goalie coverage, and league operations.

Key pages:
- https://www.rosterhockey.com/
- https://www.rosterhockey.com/features
- https://www.rosterhockey.com/line-combos-predictions
- RosterHockey vs BenchApp comparison: https://www.rosterhockey.com/rosterhockey-vs-benchapp
- RosterHockey vs TeamSnap comparison: https://www.rosterhockey.com/rosterhockey-vs-teamsnap
- RosterHockey vs Rosterlytic comparison: https://www.rosterhockey.com/rosterhockey-vs-rosterlytic
- https://www.rosterhockey.com/pricing
- https://www.rosterhockey.com/about
- https://www.rosterhockey.com/faq
- https://www.rosterhockey.com/support

RosterHockey includes line combos and pre-game predictions for winning odds, score, points and player production, on Player Pro and Commissioner.

Web app and login: https://www.roster-app.com
